environment: Isolated local macOS PHP server; SQLite Database Integration; Chromium; free editions. Email sending disabled by a lab-only filter. No production accounts or site data.

checks.title: Create and embed
checks.detail: Created a free contact template through the plugin UI and embedded its shortcode on a published page.

checks.title: Submit and retrieve
checks.detail: Submitted synthetic name, email, subject, and message fields. The public success message appeared; one database entry and its dashboard row were verified.

limitations: Email sending was disabled, so notification deliverability is not established.
Payments, Pro integrations, spam handling, high-volume behavior, and production MySQL compatibility were not tested.

checks.title: Create a local file backup
checks.detail: Started an uploads-only backup from the dashboard with database backup excluded. Ran due cron jobs in the isolated lab and verified the recorded uploads ZIP.

checks.title: Check archive contents
checks.detail: Read back the known fixture from the generated ZIP and matched its bytes to the original. The dashboard exposed the backup and restore controls.

limitations: This is an uploads-archive check, not a full plugin restore or disaster-recovery exercise.
Database backup, MySQL restores, scheduled timing, remote storage, and Premium features were not tested. SQLite is not a production MySQL test.

screenshots.alt: A completed local uploads backup and its restore controls in the isolated KreativWP plugin lab

checks.title: Activation and setup boundary
checks.detail: Activated the free plugin and opened its setup UI. It displayed the local/staging readiness warning and a Google sign-in step.

checks.title: No account changes
checks.detail: No Google authorization, service connection, Analytics configuration, or production-site change was attempted. Anonymous usage-data sharing was left off.

limitations: Connected Search Console/Analytics reports and verified public-site setup were not tested.
A public site and explicitly authorized Google account are required for a complete integration test; local activation is not proof of connected reporting.

checks.title: Report and resolve
checks.detail: Submitted a report from an anonymous visitor session, reviewed it in the dashboard, and marked it resolved.

checks.title: Export
checks.detail: Downloaded the CSV and verified the resolved report’s post ID and status.

limitations: Notifications, spam/abuse handling, and large report volumes were not tested.
This is visitor feedback, not an automatic link crawler.

checks.title: Controlled image scan
checks.detail: Scanned a fixture containing one reachable local image URL and one known missing URL. The completed report recorded the missing request as HTTP 404.

limitations: Large sites, remote hosts that block HEAD, CSS backgrounds, and responsive srcset variants were not tested.
The scan was manually started; no automatic schedule is claimed.
